bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (screenshot markup editor, shell-only); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (drawing app); springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs (pencil glyph only); no PencilKit-shaped type in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src
summary: BifrOSt has two working drawing surfaces: the shell's screenshot markup editor (pen, marker, pencil, eraser, undo, PNG save) and the Freeform app (pen, marker, eraser, palette, undo, PNG save). Neither is exposed to apps through the SDK. There is no stroke or drawing data model, no tool picker, no lasso, no curve import, no handwriting recognition and no pressure or tilt input.

features.feature: Canvas view capturing pen and finger input
features.note: Both capture Down/Move/Up touch events and stamp strokes onto a pixel buffer. No SDK view class, no low-latency pen path, and no separate pen input. Apps cannot embed a canvas.

features.feature: Drawing model (PKDrawing) and save as data
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-pencilkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The stroke list lives inside the shell and is not serialised. Both editors save a flattened PNG only (markup.rs Done, Freeform save to the screenshot directory). A drawing cannot be reopened as strokes.

features.feature: Stroke and point model (PKStroke, PKStrokePath, PKStrokePoint)
features.note: Points are x,y only, in image pixels. No per-point time, force, altitude or azimuth, and no path parameterisation or interpolation API.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:29 (Tool::brush: width and opacity per tool)
features.note: Width and opacity are fixed per tool. No ink catalogue and no per-stroke ink value, apart from colour from the markup palette.
Each editor draws its own tool and colour row. There is no system tool palette that apps can attach to a canvas, and no custom tool registration.

features.feature: Pen, marker, pencil and eraser tools (PKInkingTool, PKEraserTool)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:20 (enum Tool: Pen, Marker, Pencil, Eraser); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:42 (Tool: Pen, Marker, Eraser)
features.note: Shell has four tools, Freeform has three. Neither has a stroke-level eraser; the eraser paints over with the paper colour in Freeform and repaints from the stroke list in the shell.

Wave 3 (w3-pencilkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No selection of existing strokes, moving, or scaling of strokes.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:215 (undo, rebuilds canvas from base and remaining strokes); springboard/ui/src/undo.rs
features.note: Stroke-level undo exists in the shell editor. The UI undo model in springboard/ui/src/undo.rs is not wired to the drawing editors.

features.apple: PKStroke init from path data, Bezier import article
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-21, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Strokes are polylines only. Curve data cannot be imported.

features.apple: Controlling stroke rendering for animation and editing
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-21, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API to slice, interpolate or animate strokes. Rendering is a single pass per stroke.
No handwriting recogniser in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src. The spelling service in springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs works on typed text.
No handwriting input path for text fields or other views.

Wave 3 (w3-pencilkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Markup and Freeform handle only position on touch events. Stroke width is fixed per tool, not driven by pressure.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (Done saves the marked-up PNG over the capture); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (saves a PNG)
features.note: Both editors write PNG files. There is no SDK call that renders a drawing to an image at a chosen scale.
Depends on PencilKit's ink format versions. BifrOSt has no drawing format to version.

gaps: No SDK canvas view or drawing model: apps cannot capture, store or reopen strokes (springboard/sdk/src has no equivalent).
No serialised drawing format; both editors save flattened PNG only.
No handwriting recognition and no Scribble-style input.
No pressure, tilt or altitude data on touch input.
No lasso selection, stroke transform or Bezier path import.
No system tool picker that apps can attach to a canvas; the markup tools and palette are private to the shell.
The shell markup editor (springboard/src/shell/markup.rs) and the Freeform app each keep their own stroke code, so there is no shared drawing module.
